# Setting up environment:

```{r}
# Clean environment
rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE)) # will clear all objects including hidden objects
gc() # free up memory and report the memory usage
options(max.print = .Machine$integer.max, scipen = 999, stringsAsFactors = F, dplyr.summarise.inform = F) # avoid truncated output in R console and scientific notation
```

```{r}
# Loading relevant libraries 
library(tidyverse) # includes ggplot2, for data visualisation. dplyr, for data manipulation.
library(Seurat)
library(scuttle)
set.seed(123)
```

# import RDS file
```{r}
poolA_et_B <- readRDS("O:/Equipes_PF_Services/EQ_Duprez/EQ_Duprez/Current Lab Members/Chellal Alyssa/aml2ndaire/aml_2nd rds/020_010_042_025_008_034_095_017_filtered_with_adt.rds")
```

# Ajouter les metadata biologiques

```{r}
poolA_et_B$patient <- NA
poolA_et_B$response <- NA
poolA_et_B$timepoint <- NA
```

```{r}
# Assignation patient
poolA_et_B$patient[poolA_et_B$orig.ident %in% c("AML_OB1","AML_OB2")] <- "P1"
poolA_et_B$patient[poolA_et_B$orig.ident %in% c("AML_OB3","AML_OB4")] <- "P2"
poolA_et_B$patient[poolA_et_B$orig.ident %in% c("AML_OB5","AML_OB6")] <- "P3"
poolA_et_B$patient[poolA_et_B$orig.ident %in% c("AML_OB7","AML_OB8")] <- "P4"

# Assignation réponse
poolA_et_B$response[poolA_et_B$patient %in% c("P1","P4")] <- "refractory"
poolA_et_B$response[poolA_et_B$patient %in% c("P2","P3")] <- "responder"

# Assignation timepoint
poolA_et_B$timepoint[poolA_et_B$orig.ident %in% c("AML_OB1","AML_OB3","AML_OB5","AML_OB7")] <- "pre"
poolA_et_B$timepoint[poolA_et_B$orig.ident %in% c("AML_OB2","AML_OB4","AML_OB6","AML_OB8")] <- "post"

```

```{r}
# Vérifier
table(poolA_et_B$patient, poolA_et_B$timepoint)
table(poolA_et_B$response, poolA_et_B$timepoint)
table(poolA_et_B$orig.ident)
```

# change l'ordre

```{r}
# Transformer 'patient' en facteur avec l'ordre souhaité
poolA_et_B$patient <- factor(poolA_et_B$patient, levels = c("P1", "P4", "P2", "P3"))
table(poolA_et_B$patient)

# Transformer 'timepoint' en facteur avec l'ordre souhaité
poolA_et_B$timepoint <- factor(poolA_et_B$timepoint, levels = c("pre", "post"))
table(poolA_et_B$timepoint)

poolA_et_B$response <- factor(poolA_et_B$response, levels = c("responder", "refractory"))
table(poolA_et_B$response)
```

```{r}
saveRDS(poolA_et_B, file = "020_010_042_025_008_034_095_017_filtered_with_adt.rds")
```

# QC (quality control)

## mito

```{r}
#poolA et B
poolA_et_B[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(poolA_et_B, pattern = "^MT-")
VlnPlot(poolA_et_B, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"))
FeatureScatter(poolA_et_B, "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt")
FeatureScatter(poolA_et_B, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
VlnPlot(poolA_et_B, features = "percent.mt") + theme_linedraw()

```

## ribo

```{r}
#poolA et B
poolA_et_B[["percent.ribo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(poolA_et_B, pattern = "^RPS|^RPL")
VlnPlot(poolA_et_B, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.ribo"))
FeatureScatter(poolA_et_B, "nCount_RNA", "percent.ribo")
```

```{r}
saveRDS(poolA_et_B, file = "020_010_042_025_008_034_095_017_filtered_with_adt_qc.rds")
```

# filtering + joinlayer

```{r}
poolA_et_B <- JoinLayers(poolA_et_B)

# extracting the metric i want to check
counts_vector <- poolA_et_B$nFeature_RNA

#running is outlier
outliers <- isOutlier(counts_vector, 
                      nmads = 5, 
                      type = "both", 
                      batch = poolA_et_B$orig.ident)

table(outliers)

#filter out the outlier
poolA_et_B <- poolA_et_B[, !outliers]
```

```{r}
poolA_et_B <- JoinLayers(poolA_et_B)

# extracting the metric i want to check
counts_vector <- poolA_et_B$percent.mt

#running is outlier
outliers <- isOutlier(counts_vector, 
                      nmads = 5, 
                      type = "higher", 
                      batch = poolA_et_B$orig.ident)

table(outliers)

#filter out the outlier
poolA_et_B <- poolA_et_B[, !outliers]

VlnPlot(poolA_et_B, features = "percent.mt")
VlnPlot(poolA_et_B, features = "nFeature_RNA")

```

```{r}
# Vérifier
table(poolA_et_B$patient, poolA_et_B$timepoint)
table(poolA_et_B$response, poolA_et_B$timepoint)
table(poolA_et_B$orig.ident)
```

#save

```{r}
saveRDS(poolA_et_B, file = "020_010_042_025_008_034_095_017_filtered_with_adt_qc_outlierdrop.rds")
```
